sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Ab]I come to the garden alone, [Eb7]While the dew is still on the roses;
[Ab]And the voice I hear, falling on my ear, The Son of God discloses.
[Ab]And He walks with me, And [Db/Ab]He talks with me, And He [Ab]tells me I am His own;
[Ab]And the joy we share [Gdim]as we tarrythere, None other [Eb]has ever known.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Ab]And He walks with me, and He talks with me,
[Ab]And He tells me I am His own;
[Ab]And the joy we [Gdim]share as we [Eb/Bb]tarry there,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Ab]He speaks, and the [Eb7]sound of His voice
[Ab]Is so sweet the birds hush their singing,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Ab]Though the night around me be falling,
[Ab]But He bids me [Db/Ab]go; through the [Ab]voice of woe,
